name: sovereign-intelligence-stack
summary: The canonical 5-layer sovereign intelligence architecture: recipe compiler, signal router, autonomous evaluation, apprenticeship engine, and intelligence observatory.
problem: AI systems lack the structural coherence to operate autonomously with sovereignty. Individual components exist but don't form a unified system.
why_matters: This is the complete architecture that ties everything together — from local inference to autonomous evaluation to observability.
core_ideas: Recipe-based development: specifications as executable artifacts
Signal routing: dynamic dispatch based on task complexity
Autonomous evaluation: systems that judge their own output
Apprenticeship learning: agents learn from their own mistakes
Observability: tracking intelligence across its lifecycle

name: sovereign-intelligence-observatory
summary: Complete local-first AI observability platform that tracks, analyzes, and optimizes agent intelligence across its entire lifecycle.
problem: Once intelligence runs autonomously, you need to observe it — not just log, but understand, analyze, and improve it.
why_matters: Observability is the final layer of sovereignty. If you can't see what's happening, you don't own it.
core_ideas: Lifecycle tracking: from recipe to execution to evaluation
Intelligence metrics: measuring sovereignty, not just accuracy
Drift detection: when does intelligence degrade?
Federated sync: sharing insights across distributed systems

name: stratagent
summary: Collaborative AI development environment where specialized AI personas work together to build software projects.
problem: Single-agent development is fragile. Specialized personas (architect, reviewer, tester) working together produce better code.
why_matters: Demonstrates that sovereign intelligence isn't just one agent — it's coordinated swarms of specialized agents.
core_ideas: Specialized AI personas with distinct roles
Specification analysis, architectural design, code generation, validation, project management
User interacts naturally; AI handles the engineering

name: workflow
summary: Structured AI-assisted development methodology exploring how systems thinking guides human-AI collaboration in software engineering.
problem: AI-assisted development lacks structure. Ad-hoc prompting leads to inconsistent results.
why_matters: Provides the methodological foundation for how humans and AI collaborate on sovereign systems.
core_ideas: Systems thinking applied to human-AI collaboration
Methodology over tools: the process matters more than the implementation

name: sovereignSpec
summary: Local-first, offline spec-driven development engine that treats specifications as living, graph-grounded artifacts and enforces deterministic code generation through structured pipelines.
problem: Software specifications are static documents. They don't evolve, they don't connect to knowledge, and they don't enforce quality.
why_matters: This is the engineering layer — where architecture meets production. Spec-driven development ensures code is generated from living specifications.
core_ideas: Specs as living artifacts: specifications evolve with the system
Graph-grounded: specifications connect to knowledge graphs
Deterministic code generation: structured pipelines, no cloud APIs

name: specweave
summary: Self-verifying, speculative, multi-agent spec engine with neuro-symbolic reasoning.
problem: Single-agent spec generation lacks verification. Multi-agent systems with neuro-symbolic reasoning produce more robust specifications.
why_matters: Extends sovereignSpec with self-verification and speculative reasoning.
core_ideas: Multi-agent speculation: multiple agents propose different approaches
Neuro-symbolic reasoning: combining neural and symbolic methods

name: synthScript
summary: Semantic operating system that transforms a knowledge graph into executable software specifications — no more prompting LLMs directly.
problem: Prompting LLMs directly is fragile. Knowledge graphs provide structure and grounding.
why_matters: Bridges knowledge graphs and software specifications — the semantic layer between understanding and implementation.
core_ideas: Semantic operating system: everything is a graph operation
No direct LLM prompting: the graph drives generation

name: specgen
summary: Transform natural language specifications into production-ready application skeletons using AI-powered agentic workflows.
problem: Writing application skeletons from specifications is tedious. AI can automate this.
why_matters: Early exploration of spec-driven code generation.

name: zero-trust
summary: Security architecture for AI-generated code preventing supply chain poisoning, DLL sideloading, and trust inheritance exploits.
problem: AI-generated code introduces security risks: supply chain poisoning, DLL sideloading, trust inheritance.
why_matters: Sovereign systems must be secure. Zero-trust architecture ensures generated code can't be exploited.
core_ideas: Prevent supply chain poisoning in AI-generated code

name: orthos
summary: A locally sovereign, replayable, graph-executed cognitive system.
problem: Cognitive systems need to be replayable and graph-executed for reproducibility.
why_matters: Early exploration of graph-based cognitive systems.

name: objective
summary: Autonomous news ingestion, claim extraction, contradiction tracking, and TTS broadcast — entirely on your laptop.
problem: News consumption is passive and fragmented. Autonomous systems can ingest, analyze, and synthesize news continuously.
why_matters: First demonstration of perpetual local intelligence — a system that runs continuously, ingests information, and generates reports.
core_ideas: Autonomous news ingestion from across the web

name: objective05
summary: Perpetual intelligence and broadcasting platform — a long-running daemon that continuously ingests information, extracts entities and claims, detects events, narratives, and contradictions, maintains a living knowledge graph, and generates written reports and audio broadcasts.
problem: Intelligence systems are ephemeral. Perpetual systems that run continuously build compounding understanding.
why_matters: Evolution of the objective series — a complete perpetual intelligence system with knowledge graph and broadcasting.
core_ideas: Information ingestion from across the web
Written reports and audio broadcast generation

name: objective06
summary: Local-first intelligence infrastructure that continuously synthesizes a user's digital existence into a persistent, evolving cognitive model.
problem: Knowledge systems are static. Persistent cognitive models that evolve with use provide deeper understanding.
why_matters: Latest evolution of the objective series — focusing on persistent cognitive models.

name: synt
summary: Revolutionary, air-gapped Local-First Dynamic Persona Intelligence System that transforms large, heterogeneous corpuses into grounded, attributable, and conversationally explorable intelligence using deterministic generative models.
problem: Intelligence systems lack grounding in specific corpuses. Persona-based systems can be specialized and grounded.
why_matters: Demonstrates that synthetic intelligence can emerge from locally-hosted specialized models through dynamic persona routing.
core_ideas: Dynamic persona intelligence: specialized models for different tasks
Grounded in corpuses: intelligence derived from specific knowledge

name: SynthInt
summary: Dynamic Persona Intelligence System that transforms large, heterogeneous corpuses into grounded, attributable, and conversationally explorable intelligence.
problem: Same as synt — earlier iteration.
why_matters: Earlier iteration of the synt project.

name: dynamic_persona_moe_rag
summary: Dynamic graph-based Mixture-of-Experts RAG system using persona JSON files and a local Ollama model.
problem: Traditional RAG lacks specialization. Mixture-of-Experts routing through personas provides specialized retrieval.
why_matters: Demonstrates that RAG can be specialized through persona-based routing.

name: divine-light
summary: Unified AI memory system combining MemPalace verbatim storage, Graphify knowledge graphs, and Synt-inspired reasoning agents.
problem: Memory systems are fragmented. Unified systems combining storage, graphs, and reasoning provide deeper understanding.
why_matters: Combines multiple memory approaches into a unified system.

name: cogGraph
summary: Sophisticated cognitive routing system that transforms how AI systems process and respond to user inputs through a cognitive graph-based reasoning engine.
problem: Traditional chatbots lack cognitive depth. Graph-based reasoning engines activate modular persona subgraphs based on prompt analysis.
why_matters: Demonstrates that cognitive routing through graphs provides more sophisticated reasoning.

name: sovereign-memory-bank
summary: Seven-layer cognitive memory architecture for autonomous agents: raw documents → synthesized abstractions → cross-document insights.
problem: Agents forget between sessions. Vector stores retrieve but don't understand. Memory must be structured, layered, and self-improving.
why_matters: First system demonstrating that persistent agent memory could be autonomous and self-improving — no cloud required.
core_ideas: Seven-layer hierarchy: raw documents → synthesized abstractions → cross-document insights
Local-first: all processing on-device via Ollama
Self-improving: the memory improves as it runs
Sovereign: no data leaves the machine

name: brain-memory-graphrag-engine
summary: Unified system that combines sovereign Graph RAG with self-improving agent memory.
problem: Graph RAG and agent memory are typically separate systems. Unified systems provide deeper understanding.
why_matters: Extends sovereign-memory-bank with self-improving agent memory.

name: sovereign-knowledge-engine
summary: Local-first, sovereign knowledge system that ingests markdown documents, constructs a multi-layer knowledge graph, generates vector embeddings, performs agentic reasoning, and continuously expands its understanding through human interaction.
problem: Knowledge systems are static. Sovereign systems that continuously learn from interaction provide compounding understanding.
why_matters: Demonstrates that knowledge systems can be sovereign, local-first, and continuously learning.

name: ukb
summary: Universal Knowledge Base — Spec-driven knowledge base system. Define what you know in an .sspec file, run start.sh, get a searchable, embeddable, web-UI-equipped knowledge base.
problem: Knowledge bases are complex to set up. Spec-driven systems simplify configuration and provide structured knowledge.
why_matters: Generalizes sovereign-memory-bank into a spec-driven system — anyone can define their knowledge with .sspec files.
core_ideas: Universal: works with any knowledge base

name: blog-knowledge-base
summary: Next.js chat application that ingests markdown blog posts, constructs a knowledge graph with vector embeddings using a local LLM, and provides a RAG-based chat interface for querying blog content.
problem: Blogs are static. RAG-based chat interfaces make blog content interactive and queryable.
why_matters: Demonstrates that blogs can be transformed into interactive knowledge bases.
core_ideas: Knowledge graph construction with vector embeddings

name: LGVRAG series
summary: Local Graph + Vector RAG System with HelixDB — multiple iterations exploring graph and vector retrieval.
problem: Traditional RAG uses either graphs or vectors. Combined systems provide better retrieval.
why_matters: Multiple iterations exploring the best combination of graph and vector retrieval.

name: mindmap series
summary: Mind Map AI — Local LLM-powered Personal Knowledge Graph. Interactive mind maps from notes using local LLMs and vector embeddings.
problem: Notes are static. Interactive mind maps make knowledge visual and navigable.
why_matters: Demonstrates that local LLMs can generate interactive visualizations.

name: bot series
summary: Multiple AI chatbot and research assistant iterations exploring GraphRAG, MCP integration, and conversational interfaces.
problem: Early iterations of chatbot and research assistant systems.
why_matters: Experimental exploration of conversational interfaces.

name: basicbot
summary: Sophisticated Research Assistant powered by GraphRAG technology for analyzing documents and research data.
problem: Document analysis is manual. GraphRAG-powered research assistants automate analysis.
why_matters: Demonstrates GraphRAG for document analysis.

name: turboq
summary: Comprehensive local LLM inference platform that synthesizes research-grade KV cache optimization, graph-based agent orchestration, and distributed cluster deployment into a unified system.
problem: Local LLM inference lacks optimization, orchestration, and deployment tools.
why_matters: Comprehensive inference platform for local LLMs — from optimization to distributed deployment.
core_ideas: Multi-model routing and dynamic agent swarms

name: sovereign-scaffold
summary: Deployable, configurable sovereign AI system that you can run locally and deploy for any client.
problem: Sovereign AI systems are hard to deploy. Scaffold systems simplify deployment.
why_matters: Makes sovereign AI deployable for any client.

name: sovereign
summary: Local-first AI operating system. No cloud. No telemetry. Your inference. Your memory. Your governance.
problem: AI systems depend on cloud infrastructure. Local-first systems provide sovereignty.
why_matters: Original sovereign AI operating system — the foundation of everything that follows.

name: sse
summary: Local-first, privacy-focused Sovereign Intelligence Layer that eliminates dependency on cloud-based AI services.
problem: AI services depend on cloud infrastructure. Sovereign Intelligence Layer eliminates this dependency.
why_matters: Sovereign Intelligence Layer provides the infrastructure for cloud-free AI.

name: quantum series
summary: Post-quantum cryptography implementations for sovereign systems: q01, quantum01, quantum03, r02.
problem: Current encryption is vulnerable to quantum computing. Post-quantum cryptography ensures long-term sovereignty.
why_matters: Sovereign systems must be secure against future threats. Post-quantum cryptography ensures long-term sovereignty.

name: rlm
summary: General plug-and-play inference library for Recursive Language Models (RLMs), supporting various sandboxes.
problem: Inference libraries lack flexibility. Recursive Language Models provide more sophisticated reasoning.
why_matters: Inference library for Recursive Language Models.

name: ollama-chatbot
summary: Experimental Ollama integration for chatbot applications.
problem: Early exploration of Ollama integration.
why_matters: Early Ollama experimentation.

name: AMIS
summary: Autonomous Marketing Intelligence System — turns a corpus of Markdown blog posts into an autonomous marketing knowledge graph that plans, ranks, recommends, and generates campaigns.
problem: Marketing lacks automation. Autonomous marketing systems can plan, rank, recommend, and generate campaigns.
why_matters: Demonstrates that sovereign intelligence can be applied to marketing — autonomous knowledge graphs that generate campaigns.

name: Learn
summary: Self-hosted, personalized AI learning platform powered by local LLMs, knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation.
problem: Learning platforms are generic. Personalized AI learning platforms powered by local LLMs provide tailored education.
why_matters: Demonstrates that sovereign intelligence can be applied to education — personalized learning powered by local AI.

name: BookForge
summary: Deterministic publishing runtime that transforms structured knowledge into professionally written technical books.
problem: Writing books is manual. Deterministic publishing runtimes automate book generation from structured knowledge.
why_matters: Demonstrates that sovereign intelligence can be applied to publishing — automated book generation from knowledge.

name: catholic-kb
summary: Local-first Catholic knowledge base with AI-powered Q&A. Built with Tauri, Rust, and vanilla JavaScript.
problem: Knowledge bases for specific domains lack local-first implementations. Catholic knowledge base provides doctrinal reasoning grounded in authoritative sources.
why_matters: Demonstrates that sovereign intelligence can be applied to specific domains — Catholic knowledge with AI-powered Q&A.
core_ideas: Built with Tauri, Rust, vanilla JavaScript

name: cathkb
summary: Local-first doctrinal reasoning engine grounded exclusively in authoritative Catholic sources.
problem: Same as catholic-kb — earlier iteration.
why_matters: Earlier iteration of catholic-kb.

name: ConCreat
summary: Modern web application for creating and managing multimedia content, featuring AI-powered text-to-speech capabilities using Chatterbox.
problem: Content creation lacks local-first tools. ConCreat provides local text-to-speech for multimedia content.
why_matters: Demonstrates that local text-to-speech can be integrated into content creation.

name: autoblog01
summary: Investigates whether local LLMs can drive a complete content generation pipeline. RSS ingestion, RAG-based writing, and automated publishing on local hardware.
problem: Content generation depends on cloud APIs. Local LLMs can drive complete content pipelines.
why_matters: Demonstrates that local LLMs can drive complete content generation pipelines.

name: chrome-ai-filename-generator
summary: Studies the interaction between local inference and everyday user workflows. A concrete experiment in unobtrusive on-device AI utility.
problem: AI utilities are intrusive. Unobtrusive on-device AI can enhance everyday workflows.
why_matters: Demonstrates that local AI can enhance everyday workflows without being intrusive.

name: RedDiss
summary: Explores the practical limits of local LLMs for content analysis. Built during the Loco Local LocalLLaMa Hackathon.
problem: Content analysis depends on cloud APIs. Local LLMs can analyze content locally.
why_matters: Demonstrates that local LLMs can analyze content locally.
